method: Same-agent English/Marathi close reading, reverse paraphrase and exact recurrence, case, formula, macro and token comparison. No independent human or native-speaker review is claimed.
scope: Simultaneous recursion, course-of-values recursion, a remainder-function exercise, and primitive recursion with changing parameters.

samples.reverse_paraphrase: Simultaneous recursion defines h_0 and h_1 together from both preceding values. Course-of-values recursion supplies g with the complete coded sequence of earlier h-values, with the empty sequence at y=0, and therefore permits reference to any earlier index k(x,y)<y.
samples.checks: Both base equations, both coupled successor equations, the all-prior-values tuple, empty-sequence convention and fallback case are preserved exactly.

samples.reverse_paraphrase: Define the natural-number remainder function by course-of-values recursion: for positive y it is the value below y in x=z·y+r, and at y=0 its value is fixed as zero.
samples.checks: The official term शेष फल is used, and the strict bound, existential multiplier and totalizing zero-divisor convention are exact.

samples.reverse_paraphrase: A final recursion scheme changes the parameter vector through k at each predecessor stage: h(x,y+1) uses h(k(x),y). This scheme can still be simulated by ordinary primitive recursion.
samples.checks: The distinction between the outer x supplied to g and the transformed k(x) supplied to recursive h is preserved.
